status: posthoc user-requested normalization; not preregistered verdict
window: late41-50 per-task corrected statistic -> within-seed median -> paired avg16/rgb32 ratio -> five-seed median

definitions.R_div_sqrt_d: R/sqrt(d): removes the square-root dimension benchmark, assuming a same per-coordinate amplitude benchmark; not a universal scaling law for correlated input
definitions.R_div_sqrt_input_trace: R/sqrt(tr Sigma): removes total input variance including its coordinate scaling
definitions.width_alignment_factor: R / [RMS(W)*sqrt(h*tr Sigma)], h=100. Exact identity R^2 = RMS(W)^2*h*trSigma*factor^2. Residual is W/input covariance alignment relative to the isotropic benchmark; no causal or convergence interpretation.
